scope: All ten non-parametrised declarations in tests/test_word_comment_resolution.py: newly authored Python comments, commentsIds fallback, optional commentsExtended creation, root-thread policy and selected readback/filter predicates. Distinct from Bun's existing-extension-only comment operation.

testHelpers.use: test-local builders/readers, not distinct test cases

targetedFamily.boundary: No existing Bun comment scenario is semantically identical to Python's authored-thread/fallback/create path. Source-only mapping, no consumer execution or format-conformance claim.

verifiedAspects: On two newly authored comments, resolve first ID succeeds and a fresh unfiltered read reports first done true, second done false.
gaps: Returned order is used to identify first and second; author/body identity is not independently checked. No XML or unrelated-part preservation assertion.

verifiedAspects: Resolve result success and done true; fresh resolved-filter read contains selected ID with done true.
gaps: The test does not inspect commentsExtended XML, original anchors, unrelated package members or an independent renderer.

verifiedAspects: Resolve and reopen responses succeed, reopen reports done false, fresh open-filter read contains selected ID with done false.
gaps: Despite the native docstring, w15:done=0 is not inspected directly; archive byte custody and unrelated metadata are not checked.

verifiedAspects: New reply and reply-ID resolution succeed, response identifies original root ID, and fresh read reports root done true.
gaps: No assertion checks reply done state or proves that only root metadata changed; no unrelated-part preservation check.

verifiedAspects: After removing the first comment-paragraph w14:paraId and writing a commentsIds mapping (its original ID if present, otherwise 0F0E0D0C), a fresh read returns that mapped para_id.
gaps: The planned fixed 0F0E0D0C case is a more specific input than the native test: Python comment authoring omits w14:paraId, but that source branch is not asserted by the native test. Native equality does not independently validate a fixed literal ID.
Only one paragraph and one explicit mapping are tested. No first-versus-last paragraph precedence, commentsIds relationship/content type validity, or repair write is asserted.

verifiedAspects: Prior package lacks commentsExtended.xml; resolving succeeds, reread has truthy para_id, saved new commentsExtended entry for that ID has w15:done=1.
gaps: No check of extension relationship/content type, exact generated para ID, entry count, comment body/anchor custody or unrelated package members.

verifiedAspects: Resolve succeeds, intermediate resolved-filter count is at least one, reopen succeeds, final open-filter read contains selected ID done false. This declaration shares the reopen scenario with T3.
gaps: T7 does not assert the reopen response's done false (required by the shared scenario); the open-filter read checks the target state. Its intermediate count does not require the selected ID, and no saved XML or archive preservation is inspected.

verifiedAspects: First returned comment contains done/is_reply/parent_id/para_id keys; resolving first ID succeeds; each returned open/resolved/mine entry satisfies its respective predicate.
gaps: The planned shared scenario requires nonempty open, resolved and mine results. The native all() checks are vacuous for empty lists and grant no credit for this nonempty requirement. Exact cardinality/completeness, metadata values, case-varied author queries and archive preservation are also unasserted.

verifiedAspects: Reply creation succeeds; threaded read returns threads key and count at least one, first root ID matches original and first replies include reply ID.
gaps: No exact thread/reply count, duplicate exclusion, nesting beyond one reply, reply done flag or independent renderer check.

verifiedAspects: Reply auto_resolve returns success/resolved true and fresh resolved-filter read contains root ID done true.
gaps: No independent reply done-state, serialized commentsExtended state, comment body custody or unrelated package member preservation assertion.
